HANDLER mode installs the exact supplied ToolPolicyHandler once through R1-002 registerToolPolicy without duplicating or rewriting its policy logic.

An optional HANDLER monotonicGuard is installed exactly once only when supplied and requires toolsMonotonicGuard support.

The plugin does not create a second policy engine, approval subsystem, event bus, plugin registry, Fiber manager or Adapter runtime.
